review.assessment: This change creates `solution.sh` but leaves the script with the original buggy behavior rather than applying the requested fix. When the second argument is zero, it incorrectly prints "Infinity" to stdout and exits successfully instead of writing an error message to stderr and exiting non-zero. Normal division works correctly, but the error-handling path violates every specified requirement for the failure case.

findings.actual: Writes "Infinity" to stdout, prints nothing to stderr, exits with status 0
findings.defect: Zero-divisor output stream, content, and exit code
findings.expected: Prints an error message to stderr, writes nothing to stdout, exits non-zero
